scene_analysis.scene_overview: A sunny day in a park with a large cathedral in the background and several people walking around. The ground is covered in sand and there are trees scattered throughout the area. There are also several benches and tables set up in the park. A person is sitting on the ground feeding pigeons. The cathedral has a tall tower and intricate architecture. The sky is clear and blue.
scene_analysis.buildings: The cathedral has a mix of Gothic and Art Nouveau styles. It has a tall tower and intricate stone carvings. The roof is made of white stone and has many arches. The building is surrounded by trees and other buildings.
scene_analysis.materials: The ground is made of sand and has a few benches and tables scattered throughout. The trees are green and leafy. There are also some birds on the ground.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and tables set up in the park. They are made of wood and metal.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are tall and have green leaves. They provide shade for the people in the park.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street. They are mostly illegible but appear to be informational signs.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking along the sidewalk and sitting on benches. Some are feeding the pigeons.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is quiet and peaceful. People seem to be enjoying the scenery.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The street is busy with pedestrians and cars. There are several bicycles parked along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is lined with shops and restaurants. There are several people taking photos.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is clean and well-maintained. There are several benches and tables set up.
